title: Joint Two Strings
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: N is an integer.; 1 \leq N \leq 5 \times 10^5; S_i and T are strings of length 1 to 5 \times 10^5, inclusive, consisting of lowercase English letters.; The total length of S_1, S_2, \ldots, S_N is at most 5 \times 10^5.
